pattern: a choice only the user makes ends up as a line in the reply
experience: Workers ended their reports with 'USER ACTION:' lines for choices only the user could make. Nothing tracked them, so they were lost once the thread scrolled away.
rule: A decision or action only the user can take, while the agent keeps working: call t3_user_decision instead of writing it in the reply.
prompt: Bump lodash to 4.17.21 in package.json and run the tests. Whether we also drop the Node 18 CI job is my call, not yours. I'm in meetings all afternoon, so don't wait on me for it.

pattern: a decision the user already settled stays open
experience: An agent left the user a decision, then the user settled it in chat. The open decision kept the thread on Input until someone dismissed it by hand.
rule: When a decision the agent left no longer applies, withdraw it by requestId.
